Hi Sara — thanks for the clear notes and the annotated PDF. Quick answers up front, then a proposed paragraph below.

Short answers:
- Satellite logs are operational telemetry (health checks, RPC latencies, error counters, anonymized host identifiers). They do not contain customer prompt/content payloads or PII-derived model outputs.
- For backups/snapshots, our deletion process includes a purge ticket, storage object delete calls, and an audit-log entry. We can export a time-stamped list of ticket IDs and the corresponding storage object IDs.

Proposed DPA language (suggested insertion into Section 4.2, this preserves your 30-day default and gives an explicit addendum path):

"Satellite operational telemetry (\"satellite logs\") is defined as metrics, health checks, error traces, and anonymized host identifiers generated solely for service reliability and debugging. Satellite logs will by default be retained in the region of origin for a period not to exceed thirty (30) days. The parties may, by mutual written agreement (addendum), extend the retention period up to ninety (90) days for specified telemetry types where agreed operationally. Satellite logs will not include customer content, prompts, or unredacted PII; any such content inadvertently captured will be treated as content and handled under Section 5 (Data Subject Rights and Deletion)."

Evidence SLA for deletion of backups/snapshots (proposed):
- Redwood will provide an evidence package within ten (10) business days of a request consisting of: purge ticket IDs, object storage delete confirmations (object IDs and timestamps), and a redacted audit-log extract showing the deletion event. In cases where legal hold or regulatory obligations apply, Redwood will indicate the reason for any delay and provide an estimated delivery date.

Attachments: I've attached a compact retention matrix with columns mapped to the proposed language (retention_matrix_acme_comments.xlsx).

If this direction sounds acceptable I can incorporate the paragraph directly into the DPA and send a marked-up PDF for DocuSign routing.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
